metadata.description: Omelette's design harness: a review-before-show loop for UI work, a mood-board kickoff, and the external design skills it builds on, each pinned to a commit that was read and checked.

plugins.name: design-harness
plugins.description: Review before show (a Stop hook plus a fresh-context ui-review agent that compares each change with its sibling surfaces, the project's settled rules and the AI-look register), copy-length, drift and accessibility checks, a mood-board kickoff, and a learn skill that turns corrections into rules.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's frontend-design skill: plans a design, reviews the plan against the looks AI-generated design falls into, then builds. Used at kickoff and for anything new.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Optional, off by default: Paul Bakaus's Impeccable, critique, audit, polish, distill and 20 more commands. Its useful rules are already distilled in the harness's AI-look register. Note: its detector downloads a binary on first use.

plugins.name: modern-web-guidance
plugins.description: Google Chrome's guides to what the web platform now does natively (dialogs, styled selects, anchor positioning, view transitions). Measured by its authors at +27 to +34 points on their task suite.

plugins.name: emil-design-engineering
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skills: animate, review-animations, break-ui (worst-case data), prototype (variants behind a picker), mobile-native. The repo's whole skills folder loads, including a few platform skills (Expo, Swift).
